items.question: What is Katalog AI?
items.answer: Katalog AI is a next-generation catalog automation platform that uses Artificial Intelligence to optimize descriptions, images, and SEO for your products in a professional way.

items.question: How does Katalog AI optimize my products?
items.answer: Katalog AI analyzes every product in your catalog, detects improvement opportunities, and generates SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and metadata. On Pro and Business plans, Auto-Pilot runs this process continuously in the background — you don't have to trigger each optimization manually.

items.question: What AI models does Katalog AI use?
items.answer: We use state-of-the-art models specifically trained for e-commerce. Depending on your plan, we use Gemini Flash or Gemini Pro with RAG, ensuring maximum accuracy.

items.question: Can Katalog AI hallucinate false product information?
items.answer: Very rarely — Katalog AI includes an anti-hallucination guard that verifies each generation against real product data before publishing any changes.

items.question: What is the Brand Brain?
items.answer: The Brand Brain is a configurable brand profile where you define the tone, style, and restrictions of the copy generated by the AI. This ensures content always sounds like your brand.

items.question: What platforms does Katalog AI integrate with?
items.answer: We currently integrate natively with Shopify. BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and Magento are on our roadmap.

items.question: How long does it take to connect my store?
items.answer: Connecting your store takes less than 5 minutes. You just need your store URL and an admin access token.

items.question: Does Katalog AI modify my prices or stock?
items.answer: No. Katalog AI only reads and writes to title, description, metadata, and SEO tag fields. It never touches prices, inventory, or payment settings.

items.question: Can I change plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account panel. Changes apply at the start of the next billing cycle.

items.question: What happens if I run out of credits?
items.answer: Auto-Pilot pauses when you exhaust your monthly credits. To avoid interruptions, you can enable Auto-Scale (opt-in) from your dashboard: when you reach 80% usage, we automatically recharge 50 credits at $0.25 each. You set a monthly spending cap, and charges never exceed that limit. You can also purchase credit packs as a one-time buy at a lower per-credit rate.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: No, there is no time-limited trial. Katalog AI is a permanent freemium model — the Free plan is free forever with 15 credits that renew every month. No credit card required. Upgrade to a paid plan only when you need more capacity.

q1.question: Does Katalog AI modify my live store directly?
q1.answer: Not immediately. Katalog AI creates a staging version of your changes. You can review all proposed optimizations in our dashboard before syncing them to your live Shopify store with one click.

q2.question: How does the AI know my brand voice?
q2.answer: During onboarding, you can upload style guides. Our engine analyzes this data to adjust the tone, structure, and vocabulary in the automatically generated content.

q3.question: Is it compatible with all Shopify themes?
q3.answer: Yes, Katalog AI works at the product data level, not the theme. Changes in titles, descriptions, and tags are reflected perfectly regardless of the visual template you use.

q4.question: How long does it take to optimize my entire catalog?
q4.answer: The initial scan takes just a few minutes for stores up to 10,000 products. AI optimizations are generated in batches and are usually ready for review in under an hour.

subprocessors.deepseek_warning: DeepSeek processes data in China. By using Katalog AI, you consent to this international data transfer for the limited purpose of product reclassification. We are working to migrate this functionality to a US-hosted provider in a future update. If you do not consent to this transfer, please contact us at privacy@katalog.ai before using the reclassification feature.

patrol_logs.title: Auto-Pilot and Patrol Logs
patrol_logs.intro: When Auto-Pilot is enabled, we log each patrol execution to substantiate our service performance claims (required by FTC §5 and similar regulations). These logs include:
items: Plan tier at time of patrol
Number of products processed, succeeded, and failed
LLM provider used (Gemini, Groq, or DeepSeek)
patrol_logs.retention_text: Patrol logs are retained for 24 months, then automatically deleted.
patrol_logs.access_text: You can request a copy of your patrol logs by emailing privacy@katalog.ai. We will respond within 30 days.

llm_logs.title: LLM Usage Logs
llm_logs.intro: We log each LLM (AI) call for cost monitoring and audit purposes. These logs include:
llm_logs.retention_text: LLM usage logs are retained for 12 months, then automatically deleted.
llm_logs.purpose_text: These logs are used solely for internal cost monitoring and debugging. They are never shared with third parties.

credit_allocation.title: Credit Allocation by Plan
credit_allocation.patrol_definition: What "patrol" means: Auto-Pilot runs in the background, periodically checking for products that need optimization. Each "patrol" is one execution cycle, processing up to the patrol limit number of products.
credit_allocation.credit_consumption: Each product that Auto-Pilot optimizes consumes 1 credit. If a product fails to optimize (due to API error, rate limit, etc.), the credit is automatically refunded to your account.
credit_allocation.parallel_processing: On Pro and Business plans, multiple products may be processed in parallel within a single patrol to improve throughput. Each product still goes through the full optimization pipeline (audit, generate proposals, evaluate, publish).

ai_providers.title: AI Providers
ai_providers.intro: Katalog AI uses multiple AI providers to deliver optimization services:
ai_providers.gemini: Google Gemini (primary) — Used for product optimization, critique, and research.
ai_providers.groq: Groq (fallback) — Used when Gemini is unavailable or rate-limited.
ai_providers.deepseek: DeepSeek — Used for product reclassification (processes data in China).
ai_providers.no_warranty_text: We do not guarantee that AI-generated optimizations will improve conversion rates, SEO rankings, or revenue. AI output is provided "as is" and should be reviewed by the merchant before publication.
ai_providers.data_processing_text: Your product data is sent to these AI providers for processing. See our Privacy Policy for details on data transfers and retention.
